Oxygen estimate assumptions

Travel at an assumed 2 km/h, including the return leg, plus waypoint activity time. The estimate uses 0.075 kg O₂ per astronaut-hour from the NASA life support baseline. It covers breathing only. Suit losses and emergency reserves are excluded.

MAP LAYERS

Topography shows 50 m elevation bands. Hazards mark slopes above 10° in amber and above 18° in red. Minerals shows mapped CRISM classes. Thermal inertia comes from THEMIS observations.

USGS Mars 2020 CTX DEM. Terrain slopes are calculated between elevation samples. Rocks and other hazards below the raster resolution are outside the model.
